title: Online shopping
about: Buying things on the internet: choosing clothes by size, colour and price, adding them to your basket, your order and delivery address, paying by credit card and waiting for the delivery.

parts.title: Language help
parts.note: Поштовий індекс у Британії — post code (часто пишуть разом: postcode), у США — zip code. Британський індекс має і букви, і цифри (наприклад, BA1 1LZ), американський — тільки цифри (наприклад, 10509). Індекс пишуть у кінці адреси. Деякі слова з цього юніту в Британії та США різні.

items.pattern: a sale · in the sale · the summer / winter sale
items.meaning: a time when a shop sells things cheaper than usual
items.example: These boots were half price in the **sale**.
more: The **sale** starts on Monday, so I'll wait.
I always look at the **sale** page first.
items.watchOut: На розпродажі — британською зазвичай in the sale. On sale часто означає просто «у продажу», хоча в американській англійській — теж «зі знижкою».

items.pattern: search for sth · search for products · the search box
items.meaning: try to find something, for example on a website
items.example: I **searched for** a red scarf, but the shop didn't have one.
more: Mum **searched for** cheap train tickets online.
Type 'jeans' in the box and click **search**.
items.watchOut: Шукати щось — search for sth (з for). Без for після search стоїть місце, де шукають: search the website for a scarf.

items.pattern: a product · products · shop by product
items.meaning: a thing that a shop or a company makes or sells
items.example: This shop sells **products** for cats and dogs.
more: All their **products** are made in Italy.
Look at the photos before you choose a **product**.
items.watchOut: Product — будь-який товар, не лише їжа. «Продукти» (їжа) — food або groceries, а не products.

items.pattern: a T-shirt · a top · T-shirts and tops
items.meaning: clothes for the top half of your body; a T-shirt has short sleeves and no buttons
items.example: I need a white **T-shirt** for PE lessons.
more: She bought a pretty summer **top** with flowers on it.
This **T-shirt** is too big. I need a smaller one.
items.watchOut: Top — не тільки «топ» без рукавів: так називають будь-яку легку кофтинку, блузку чи футболку.

items.pattern: a jumper · a warm / wool jumper
items.meaning: a warm piece of clothing with long sleeves that you put on over your head
items.example: It's cold outside. Put on your **jumper**.
more: My aunt gave me a blue **jumper** for my birthday.
I'm looking for a **jumper** in size medium.
items.watchOut: Британською — jumper, американською — sweater. Зі стрибками (jump) у цьому значенні не пов'язане.

items.pattern: trousers / jeans are… · a pair of trousers / jeans
items.meaning: clothes for your legs; jeans are trousers made of strong blue cotton
items.example: These **trousers** are too long. I need a shorter pair.
more: My favourite **jeans** have a hole in the knee.
Dad wears black **trousers** to work.
items.watchOut: Trousers і jeans — завжди множина: My jeans are new (не is). Одні штани — a pair of trousers. Американською штани — pants, а британською pants — це труси.

items.pattern: a pair of shoes / boots · shoes and boots
items.meaning: shoes cover your feet; boots cover your feet and the bottom of your legs
items.example: These **shoes** are too small for me now.
more: My **boots** are wet from the snow.
My grandad cleans his **shoes** every Sunday.
items.watchOut: Shoes — це і «туфлі», і взуття загалом. Boots — черевики або чоботи: взуття, яке закриває щиколотку.

items.pattern: a jacket · a coat · a winter coat
items.meaning: clothes you wear over other clothes when you go out; a coat is usually longer and warmer
items.example: Take a **jacket**. It's cool this evening.
more: In winter I wear a long warm **coat**.
Hang your **jacket** on the chair.
items.watchOut: Jacket — і куртка, і піджак. Теплу зимову куртку часто теж називають coat або winter coat.

items.pattern: cotton · a cotton T-shirt / dress · 100% cotton
items.meaning: a soft natural material from a plant; we make clothes from it
items.example: **Cotton** T-shirts are nice in hot weather.
more: This shirt is 100% **cotton**.
My bed sheets are white **cotton**.
items.watchOut: Матеріал стоїть перед річчю без змін: a cotton T-shirt. Вимова /ˈkɒtn/ — друге «о» майже не чути.

items.pattern: What colour…? · in red / in blue · five colours
items.meaning: red, blue, white and so on
items.example: What **colour** do you want, white or blue?
more: This jumper comes in five **colours**.
My favourite **colour** is green.
items.watchOut: Британське написання — colour, американське — color. Питають What colour…? без of: What colour is your bag?

items.pattern: What size are you? · size small / medium / large · the wrong size
items.meaning: how big clothes or shoes are
items.example: These shoes are the wrong **size**. They're too small.
more: I'm a **size** small in T-shirts.
Check the **size** before you order.
items.watchOut: «Який у тебе розмір?» природніше — What size are you? Розміри одягу: small (S), medium (M), large (L).

items.pattern: the price of sth · a good / low / high price
items.meaning: how much money you pay for something
items.example: The **price** of this T-shirt is £6.99.
more: The **prices** at the market are lower than in the shops.
Compare the **prices** before you buy.
items.watchOut: Про ціну зазвичай кажуть high / low price, а expensive / cheap — про саму річ: the jacket is expensive. Не плутай price /praɪs/ і prize /praɪz/ (приз).

items.pattern: free delivery · get free delivery · delivery is free
items.meaning: you don't pay for the shop to bring things to you
items.example: Orders over £20 get **free delivery**.
more: I chose **free delivery** because I wasn't in a hurry.
Is there **free delivery** on books?
items.watchOut: Free тут — «безкоштовний», а не «вільний».

items.pattern: next day delivery · choose next day delivery
items.meaning: the shop brings your things the day after you buy them
items.example: I paid for **next day delivery** because I need the shoes for Saturday.
more: **Next day delivery** costs £5.99.
If you order before 6 pm, you can get **next day delivery**.

items.pattern: add sth to your basket · your basket · in your basket
items.meaning: put something in your online list of things to buy
items.example: I **added** two T-shirts **to my basket**.
more: You have three things in your **basket**.
I **added** the boots **to my basket**, but then I changed my mind.
items.watchOut: Додати в кошик — add to your basket (не add in). Британською — basket, американською — cart.

items.pattern: delete sth · delete this item
items.meaning: take something away from a list or a screen
items.example: This item is the wrong colour. I'll **delete** it.
more: Click the bin to **delete** an item.
Oops, I **deleted** the wrong T-shirt!
items.watchOut: Вимова /dɪˈliːt/ — наголос на другому складі.

items.pattern: your order · order sth (online)
items.meaning: the things you ask a shop to send you; to ask a shop for things
items.example: My **order** arrived this morning.
more: I **ordered** a birthday present for Dad online.
You can see your **order** on the next page.
items.watchOut: «Зробити замовлення» зазвичай кажуть просто I ordered… або place an order. Make an order звучить менш природно.

items.pattern: an order number · your order number is…
items.meaning: the number a shop gives your order, so you can ask about it later
items.example: Write down your **order number** in case there is a problem.
more: Your **order number** is in the email from the shop.
I called the shop and gave them my **order number**.

items.pattern: an item · items in your basket
items.meaning: one thing in a list, or one thing you buy
items.example: There are four **items** in my basket.
more: We don't have this **item** in blue.
Each **item** costs £3.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈaɪtəm/ — «айтем», не «ітем».

items.pattern: the total · Total: £13.98 · in total
items.meaning: all the money you pay when you add the prices together
items.example: Two T-shirts and a cap: the **total** is £20.
more: The **total** with delivery was £18.
Check the **total** before you pay.
items.watchOut: «Разом, усього» — in total: We paid £30 in total.

items.pattern: a delivery address · name, house number, street, city, post code, country
items.meaning: the address where the shop sends your things
items.example: I gave my grandma's address as the **delivery address**.
more: Check your **delivery address**. Is the street right?
My **delivery address** is different because I'm on holiday.
items.watchOut: Address пишеться з двома d і двома s. Порядок в англійській адресі: номер будинку, вулиця, місто, індекс, країна: 12 Park Road, Leeds, LS6 2AB, UK.

items.pattern: house number · live at number 27
items.meaning: the number of a house or building in a street
items.example: Our **house number** is 27.
more: The driver couldn't find us because our **house number** is very small.
Don't forget your **house number** and your flat number.
items.watchOut: В англійській адресі номер будинку стоїть перед назвою вулиці: 27 Green Street.

items.pattern: a post code (UK) · a zip code (US)
items.meaning: letters and numbers at the end of an address that help post arrive at the right place
items.example: What's your **post code**? I need it for the delivery.
more: Our new **post code** starts with two letters.
Write the **post code** clearly on the envelope.
items.watchOut: Індекс — post code або postcode (UK), zip code (US). Не index: index англійською — покажчик у кінці книжки.

items.pattern: a phone number · your phone number is…
items.meaning: the numbers you use to call someone
items.example: Can I have your **phone number**? I'll call you later.
more: I wrote the wrong **phone number** on the form.
My grandma writes all our **phone numbers** in a little book.
items.watchOut: Номер телефону — phone number, без of: не number of phone.

items.pattern: an email · an email address · send sb an email
items.meaning: a message you send over the internet; also your address for these messages
items.example: The shop sent me an **email** about my order.
more: What's your **email** address?
I check my **email** every evening.
items.watchOut: Знак @ читається at, а крапка — dot: anna at mail dot com.

items.pattern: the checkout · go to (the) checkout
items.meaning: the place on a website or in a shop where you pay
items.example: When your basket is ready, go to the **checkout**.
more: At the **checkout**, you type your address and pay.
There was a long queue at the **checkout** in the supermarket.
items.watchOut: Checkout — і кнопка «Оформити замовлення» на сайті, і каса в супермаркеті. Check out (два слова) — дієслово, наприклад виїжджати з готелю.

items.pattern: shop online · buy sth online · online shopping
items.meaning: buy things on the internet
items.example: My aunt likes to **shop online** because she's very busy.
more: **Online shopping** is quick, but sometimes the clothes are the wrong size.
Do you **shop online** or go to the shops?
items.watchOut: В інтернеті — online, без in і без the: shop online, buy it online. Можна й on the internet, але не in internet.

items.pattern: a credit card · pay by credit card · pay with a credit card
items.meaning: a plastic card from a bank that you use to pay
items.example: Dad paid for the tickets with his **credit card**.
more: Can I pay by **credit card**?
Type the numbers from your **credit card** here.
items.watchOut: «Платити карткою» — pay by card або pay with a card. У побуті часто кажуть просто card або bank card.

items.pattern: an (online) review · read / write a review
items.meaning: what people write on the internet about a thing they bought, good or bad
items.example: The jacket has great **online reviews**, so I'm going to buy it.
more: My sister writes **reviews** of books on her blog.
Most **reviews** say the shoes are a bit small.
items.watchOut: Відгук — a review. Залишити відгук — write / leave a review. Feedback — відгуки загалом, це слово незлічуване: не a feedback.

items.pattern: a delivery · wait for / get a delivery · deliver sth
items.meaning: when a driver brings things to your home; the things they bring
items.example: I'm staying at home today because I'm waiting for a **delivery**.
more: The **delivery** came at eight in the morning.
They **deliver** pizza until midnight.
items.watchOut: Доставити — deliver (дієслово), доставка — delivery (іменник).

warmup.explain: В інтернеті — online (без in). Можна й on the internet.
Індекс — post code (UK) або zip code (US). Index — покажчик у книжці.

warmup.uk: Ціни в цьому магазині дуже низькі.
warmup.q: The ___ in this shop are very low.
warmup.explain: Ціна — price. Prize — приз, pay — платити.

warmup.q: I read the ___ before I buy something.

warmup.explain: Платити карткою — pay by card або pay with a card.
Розмір одягу чи взуття — size: What size are you?

warmup.uk: Мама замовила в інтернеті нову лампу.
warmup.explain: Замовити товар — order sth. Book — бронювати (квиток, номер у готелі).

example.title: New boots for Saturday
example.uk:
У четвер Софія шукала в інтернеті футбольні бутси. Вона прочитала відгуки й вибрала чорну пару. Ціна була хороша, бо бутси були на розпродажі.

Вона додала бутси в кошик і вибрала доставку наступного дня. Мама заплатила кредитною карткою.

У п'ятницю Софія чекала вдома на доставку. О четвертій приїхав водій. Бутси були саме того розміру! У суботу Софія забила два голи.
example.en:
On Thursday, Sofia [[searched for|a2]] football boots online. She read the [[reviews|c3]] and chose a black pair. The [[price|a12]] was good because they were in the [[sale|a1]].

She [[added the boots to her basket|a15]] and chose [[next day delivery|a14]]. Her mum paid with a [[credit card|c2]].

On Friday, Sofia waited at home for the [[delivery|c4]]. At four o'clock, the driver came. The boots were the right [[size|a11]]! On Saturday, Sofia scored two goals.
